protocol.training_cap_reconstruction: sorted training paths, random.Random(42).shuffle, first 16384 indices
protocol.teacher: Object-Pro native JPEG/Lanczos3/crop/processor pixels; BF16 intact tower
protocol.student: raw decoded 256 RGB to frozen HPCM and FP16 Adapter; actual spliced FP32 posterior and BF16 output
protocol.oracle: replace Adapter block-2 output in memory with intact teacher block-2 patch tokens; actual spliced posterior/wrapper
protocol.oracle_with_prefix: offline-only restoration of intact block-2 prefix/register tokens before the same posterior; not a deployable Adapter path
protocol.student_with_teacher_dino_prefix: same HPCM/Adapter 256 DINO patch predictions; only the intact DINO CLS+4 registers inserted before posterior block 3 in memory
protocol.action: three independent simulator fresh-reset pairs, fixed zero proprio; no environment step or formal state

precision.prefix_injection: teacher BF16 CLS+registers cast to FP32 together with FP16 Adapter patches; suffix executes FP32; final cast BF16
